CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE CHANDRA SHEKHAR JHA  ORAL ORDER 3 07-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2.

The accused/petitioners are named in the FIR and apprehending their arrest in connection with Mahnar P.S. Case No.129 of 2024 registered under Sections 366(A), 376, 511/34 of the Indian Penal Code (in short 'I.P.C.') and Section 8, 12 POCSO Act.
3. The allegations against the petitioners is to help the main co-accused Pinkesh Kumar and they also made an attempt to outrage the minor daughter of the informant aged about 15 years.
The occurrence alleged to be taken place at Chakla Shahi.
Patna High Court CR.
The members of the petitioners' family are also alleged to be involved in the occurrence.

4. It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioners that the present implications took Baby Kumar @ Babby Rajak @ Boby Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190962804/
1 place out of certain neighbourhood dispute and differences, which now appears to have been compromised and thereafter a compromise petition was preferred by the informant before the learned Special Court itself, retracting the earlier version of the allegations.

entities.text: Baby Kumar @ Babby Rajak @ Boby Kumar vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that even as per the FIR, the thrust of allegation is available against Pinkesh Kumar and not against these petitioners.
Petitioners are said to be men of clean antecedents.

5. Learned APP has opposed the prayer of bail.
6.
Mr. Satish Kumar Sinha, learned counsel appearing for the informant also approves the factum of compromise as submitted aforesaid.

7. Considering the aforesaid factual submissions and by taking note of the fact as allegations as per the FIR is mainly available against co-accused Pinkesh Kumar, who is not the petitioner for the present coupled with the fact that the issues and differences out of which the present implications was raised also appears compromised, accordingly, the petitioners, above- named, who are men of clean antecedents, are directed to be Patna High Court CR.
